title: Fixed Suspended-Mass Drum Seismograph
description: One newly authored complete fixed spring-suspended mass and horizontal recording-drum instrument display. Four finite feet and a common plinth carry a rear two-post portal with a real continuous helical suspension, one thick hanging mass, a long forward recording arm and stylus, and an independently supported horizontal blank drum with end heads, axle and side handwheel. All whole numeric geometry is new; no clock, churn or optical drum imported. One static game-art prop and zero scenes. Opaque solid PBR only, no graph or readings. No seismic sensing, response, calibrated motion, paper transport, working linkage, scientific accuracy, manufacturing, load or safety claim.
